d: David talks about being named one of Vogue’s Best Dressed People of 2026, Dax Shepard cutting his hair, writing in his diary about every haircut he’s ever gotten, going to the Oscars and Vanity Fair afterparty, doing long book signings and making conversation with everyone, lying to strangers, working on a project for The New Yorker about a brothel, his new book The Land and its People, and he does a special drawing for Jimmy.
